title: Shadow Queen's Amazing Relic
description: Shadow Queen's Amazing Relic — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Tilles the Sellout

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect 1 of The Shadow Queen's Amazing Paper Crown Relics from within The Shadow's Embrace and return to Tilles the Sellout.

Quest Reward: 20 King's Coins

Return to: Tilles the Sellout

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Collect 1 of The Shadow Queen's Amazing Paper Crown Relics from within The Shadow's Embrace and return to Tilles the Sellout.

Offer:

Private Buyer Looking for an Amazing Relic!
WANTED: 1 of The Shadow Queen's Amazing Paper Crown Relics. Looking for something hot to jazz up my giant lava pool. Contact Tilles the Sellout for more info.

Turn-in:

You have a knack for finding these Relics. I'll contact the person who posted the ad on your behalf.

Objectives:

  • Shadow Queen's Amazing Relic ×1

Level range: 45–100
